subject: Archaeology
title: Ancient Climate Lessons
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ancient Climate Lessons.

hook.text: Civilizations collapsed from climate change before. Archaeology shows what went wrong.

buildup.text: The Akkadian Empire collapsed around 2200 BCE when drought cut rainfall by 30 percent.

discovery.text: Maya cities were abandoned during a century-long drought. Soil erosion prevented recovery.

twist.text: Climate was the trigger, but mismanagement made it fatal. Flexible societies survived.

climax.text: Archaeologists now model past collapses to give modern policymakers real case studies.

punchline.text: Every collapsed civilization thought it would last forever.

quiz.question: What pattern does archaeology reveal about past climate collapses?
options: Climate was the trigger but mismanagement made it fatal
